menuNote: Saint-François : alizés d'est, lagon et Désirade

origin.what: centroid of the main sport landing area (mown zone W of the taxiway loop, 0.79 ha)

runways.evidence: SIA eAIP CAR-SAM-NAM AD 2.TFFC (AIRAC 2026-10-01) AD 2.12: THR 11 16°15'29.55"N 061°15'54.09"W, THR 29 16°15'26.42"N 061°15'34.58"W, 584 x 18 m paved, true 099/279 (QFU 114/294 mag). Both THR points fall on the painted thresholds of the IGN 2024 orthophoto within ~5 m; designators 11 and 29 painted. OSM way 51203850 (asphalt, width 18) agrees.

landingAreas.name: Zone de poser principale (mown grass W of the taxiway loop)
landingAreas.evidence: Mown zone clearly visible on IGN orthophotos 2022 (mown square ~64x48 m with a ~27 m ring and letters mown in the grass) and 2024 (L-shaped mown zone with a ~20 m disc and a mown lane running SE toward the hangars). ENR 5.5 drop zone 9715 reference point 16°15'28"N 061°15'58"W lies 25 m from the disc; VAC TFFC ATT 01 (AMDT 11/19, 'CHG: cible para') shows the parachute target symbol SW of THR 11. Only mown area on the field, so assumed to serve tandems and students too. Colour = dry-season mown grass (Esri, dry) ; wet season it is grey-green (#5a5955 on IGN 2024).

target.surface: grass (mown disc, shorter than the rest of the zone)
target.evidence: IGN 2024 z19: lighter disc ~20 m across at this point with a mown lane leaving it to the SE; IGN 2022 shows a ~27 m ring 23 m SE of it (16.257846,-61.26601), so the disc moves between seasons. No pea-gravel or sand pit visible on any imagery.

pattern.description: NOT PUBLISHED - inferred. Trade wind from E-ESE almost every day, so final heading ~100° (parallel to RWY 11) from the west onto the mown zone. Suggested left-hand pattern: downwind at ~300 m AGL heading ~280° along the north side of the runway's west half and the rough grass between the runway and the D118; base turning south at the west end over the field near the D118/Route de l'Aérodrome junction (~250 m W of the target); final ~150 m long over the west arm of the zone. Mirror image (final heading ~280° over the loop) on the ~10% of days without trade wind. The runway, taxiway loop and ULM parking are just east of the zone: they are the long-landing hazard.
pattern.noOverfly: VAC TFFC ATT 01 no-overfly areas (for aircraft, also sensible under canopy): Saint-François town + marina (SW; ellipse centred ~16.2532,-61.2707, ~2.3 x 1.0 km), Résidence du Golf (NW; ~16.2590,-61.2703), La Coulée houses (E; ~16.2610,-61.2557). The marina basin and the lagoon start ~650 m S-SSW of the target: no outs there. Hangar roofs and the D118 road (with overhead lines, assumed) border the zone.
pattern.landingDirection: Into the wind: final heading ~100° with the usual E-ESE trade wind (E/ESE/SE/ENE = 84% of daytime METAR at TFFR); runway 11 is the aircraft runway in use for the same reason.
pattern.holdingArea: Upwind (east) of the landing area over the aerodrome: above the runway / airfield grass between the hangars and the D118, around 16.2580,-61.2620 (~450 m E of the target), down to ~300 m AGL. Stay north of the shoreline (Avenue de l'Europe) and west of La Coulée.

jumpRun.aircraft: Cessna 206 (club-owned, up to 5 jumpers; F-GERB in the 2022 BEA report)
jumpRun.description: Drop zone 9715 (AIP ENR 5.5): SFC-FL165, centred 16°15'28"N 061°15'58"W, contact Raizet APP 121.3 MHz (class D TMA above 2500 ft AMSL) and A/A 123.5. Licensed jumpers' seats are sold for 3200 m, tandems exit at 3000 m (open ~1500 m), climb 20-25 min. With the trade wind the run heads east (~100°) from about overhead the field along the runway line and the south coast toward Pointe des Châteaux, exits upwind; in the BEA 2022 case (ESE 10-15 kt) groups exited between overhead the aerodrome and Plage de la Douche (16.2531,-61.2307, 3.8 km E of the target) at FL100 and canopies flew west back to the field. Exact run length and spot are guessed.

wind.station: TFFR Pointe-à-Pitre Le Raizet METAR (10 m anemometer, ~28 km W of the DZ; no METAR exists for TFFC, TFFA or TFFM in the IEM archive)
wind.notes: Trade wind (alizé): E 28%, ESE 28%, SE 16%, ENE 12% of daytime reports; calm 0.1%, variable 2%. Median 20 km/h (p25 17, p75 24, p90 28). Main season Dec-Apr (carême, dry): 0°:0.6%@11.1, 22.5°:0.8%@13.0, 45°:2.7%@18.5, 67.5°:15.8%@22.2, 90°:32.3%@20.4, 112.5°:23.8%@22.2, 135°:13.4%@20.4, 157.5°:4.3%@18.5, 180°:2.1%@16.7, 337.5°:1.0%@14.8; median 20 km/h. Jun-Nov (hivernage): 0°:0.5%@9.3, 22.5°:0.7%@11.1, 45°:2.3%@16.7, 67.5°:10.7%@20.4, 90°:26.3%@20.4, 112.5°:28.5%@20.4, 135°:16.4%@20.4, 157.5°:6.0%@16.7, 180°:3.5%@16.7, 202.5°:0.5%@12.0, 337.5°:0.5%@13.0; median 18 km/h, weakest Sep-Nov (17 km/h, more S-SE, the club closes ~28/09-10/11). Diurnal: median 18 km/h at 09h, 22 km/h 11-14h, 17 km/h at 17h. Saint-François is the exposed eastern tip of Grande-Terre, so the real wind there is probably a little stronger and more easterly than at Le Raizet (inland, sheltered); BEA notes TFFR runway 30 is used only ~30 days/year, when the trade wind fails.

colors.notes: Imagery seasons differ: Esri World Imagery (z17 max here) is a dry-season scene - airfield and landing zone tan/olive (#726d50, mown zone #988e6f), golf #80805a-#979373, bunkers #cfc59c. IGN 2024 (and 2022) are wet-season and greener/greyer (airfield #4f4b4a-#615554, loop grass #3f4a3e). Suggested hexes are a dry-season (Dec-Apr, the jumping high season) compromise. Fields = cane (green), young cane/pasture, ploughed red-brown soil (the long strip N of the D118). Scrub = dense dry coastal forest/bush of the Pointe des Châteaux peninsula and La Coulée. No mangrove is mapped near the DZ (small wetland W of town at 16.2512,-61.2811); colour is generic. Beach = white coral sand (IGN #e7e3de at Raisins Clairs). Lagoon = turquoise over sand/reef inside the barrier reef (S2 #3da299); deep sea = S2 navy (#0b182c) lightened; the shelf between reef and deep water is mid blue (~#1d5a70) with dark seagrass patches.

invented: Canopy pattern side, legs and holding area: nothing published; inferred from the trade wind and the layout (left-hand, final ~100°).
Landing area use: one mown zone seen; assumed shared by sport jumpers, tandems and students; no separate student or swoop area found.
Target: a mown grass disc (radius ~10 m) whose exact place changes between photos; no pea-gravel pit seen.
Building heights (shadows unusable on the near-zenith 2024 photo) and all wall colours.
Functions of buildings other than the OSM-named Caraïbe Parachutisme hangar and the terminal (A = snack per Google Maps pin, C/H/D hangars, E office).
Jump run length/spot (only one documented case, BEA 2022) and exit altitude for licensed jumpers (3200 m from the price list, tandems 3000 m).
Wind at the DZ itself (TFFR 28 km W is the only METAR); mangrove colour (no mangrove near the DZ).
